therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: pain reduction and opioid requirement reduction
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: breast cancer patients with chronic pain due to malignancy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: overall pain relief measured by Brief Pain Inventory pain severity score

results.effect_size: Mean BPI pain severity score: 0.5 (sulfasalazine) vs 1.9 (placebo)
results.dose_information: 0.5 gram three times daily for 1 week, then 1 gram three times daily for remainder of 3 months, taken with meals
